_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score band 47-54 coil with flat-to-negative funding, muted 30d momentum and non-confirmed downside cluster keeps the rung in place until momentum or CVD breaks the stated gates.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward is Complacency/HOLD on BTC factors; narrative only describes metals/oil price prints with no phase or direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: Composite holds 47-54 with BTC chopping, momentum 35-55, funding near zero
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum <30 with CVD ≤15 and accelerating 30d decline (→ Anxiety), or momentum 60+ with CVD recovery and funding positive (→ Disbelief)
